_comment: Prisoners ledger for Palestine by the Numbers. Addameer publishes no machine-readable API, so the newsroom maintains this file from Addameer's periodic updates (with the Detainees Commission and the Prisoners' Society); the daily editor cycle refreshes it when new figures publish. Keys must match PR_KEYS in gaza_panel.py.
_note: Site review 2026-09-03: refreshed from Addameer's statistics page (figures dated 17 August 2026: 9,400 political prisoners, 3,198 administrative detainees, 1,358 Gaza detainees held as 'unlawful combatants', 92 women, 370 children). The previous ledger (14 April 2026) had gone unrefreshed for twenty weeks. Daily-editor sweep 2026-09-13: rechecked Addameer's statistics page, which currently displays a 7 July 2026 snapshot (9,400 total unchanged, but 3,244 administrative detainees, 1,320 Gaza/unlawful-combatant, 99 women, 350 children — all different sub-figures from the 17 August set already on file, despite the earlier date shown). The Commission of Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs separately put the total above 9,600 in April and above 9,500 in May 2026, both consistent with this file's range but neither a clean, dated replacement for the current breakdown. Given the conflicting dates and no unambiguous newer full breakdown found, this file's asOf and figures are left unchanged rather than replaced with a lower-confidence set; next sweep should try Addameer or the Commission directly for a report explicitly dated after 17 August 2026.
